assertion.description: Complete source-grounded restatement of the scientific meaning; do not add information absent from the evidence
assertion.title: Assertion

context.description: Optional explicit biological, experimental, clinical, organismal, tissue, cellular, disease-state, cohort, environmental, or comparable setting/condition needed to interpret where or under what conditions the relation holds; do not use for mechanisms, another relation, or another entity interaction
context.title: Context

effects.description: Optional explicit effects or outcomes; do not infer them and use an empty list when not applicable
effects.title: Effects

intervention.description: Optional explicit intervention or perturbation material to the assertion; leave null when not applicable
intervention.title: Intervention

negated.description: Whether the asserted relation is explicitly negated
negated.title: Negated

predicate.description: Concise normalized predicate faithfully describing the asserted relation
predicate.title: Predicate
